lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the branchial region, organized into roughly four horizontal tiers along the lateral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the primary horizontal spot trajectories, forming identifiable vertices in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Primary lateral carina exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient (high luminance dorsal, low luminance ventral) extending horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank.
